equipment.title: 2 HP 4-Impeller Electric Paddle Wheel Aerator
equipment.description: 100% pure copper winding motor, 4 UV-resistant reinforced nylon impellers, 304 stainless steel frame. Standard aeration rate: 2.6 kg O2/hr. Ideal for 1-acre intensive carp and shrimp ponds.

equipment.title: 32% Crude Protein Extruded Floating Fish Feed (2mm & 3mm)
equipment.description: Formulated with premium marine fish meal, toasted soybean, and vitamins. FCR 1.25 - 1.45. Minimum 98% water stability floating for 12 hours. Tested for high growth in Tilapia and Pangasius.

equipment.title: Certified Disease-Free Rohu, Catla & Mrigal Fingerlings (3 - 4 Inch)
equipment.description: Acclimatized, disease-resistant fingerlings with vigorous swimming activity. Conditioned with oxygen packing for 24-hour transport. 98%+ survival rate guaranteed.

equipment.title: Digital Optical Dissolved Oxygen (DO) & Temperature Meter
equipment.description: Luminescent optical DO sensor requiring zero membrane replacement and zero electrolyte refilling. Range 0.0 - 20.0 mg/L with ±0.2 mg/L precision. IP67 waterproof housing.

equipment.title: Concentrated Bacillus Probiotic Blend (Water & Soil Conditioner)
equipment.description: High-potency consortium of Bacillus subtilis, licheniformis, and megaterium (5 × 10^9 CFU/g). Rapidly degrades pond bottom sludge, converts ammonia/nitrite, and prevents toxic gas build-up.

equipment.title: 500 Micron UV-Stabilized HDPE Geomembrane Pond Liner
equipment.description: Virgin raw material with carbon black UV inhibitors. Puncture resistance > 240 N. Tested 10-year outdoor lifespan for zero seepage earthen fish ponds and biofloc round tank installations.

equipment.title: 3 HP Three-Phase Roots Air Blower with Aerotube Diffusers
equipment.description: Continuous duty positive displacement rotary lobe blower delivering 1,800 L/min air volume at 0.035 MPa. Complete with silencer, pressure gauge, and 100m nanobubble aerotube.

equipment.title: Commercial Knotless HDPE Drag Harvest Net (80 ft × 18 ft)
equipment.description: Heavy lead sinkers, durable EVA foam floats, double-stitched border ropes. Mesh size 25mm suitable for market-size harvest of Indian Major Carps and Tilapia without gill injury.
